task_spec.retrieval_strategy: One aggregate_source_records call uses bounded parallel cross-source execution (at most eight workers) over every parsed qualified execution route, aggregates in stable order, and returns the primary cross-source Bundle; per-source pagination remains sequential. The public 512-item/16-MB Bundle capacity is shared by execution route, typed partial and truncated outcomes remain limitations, and no claim is made that every upstream record was retrieved. MaterialsGalaxy summary is one provider-level execution route; child dataset identities on returned records remain exact provenance and are not separate outcomes. Exact follow-up uses only three preregistered targets: C2DB 1MoS2-1 remains source-summary context; Materials Project mp-2815 supplies one structure, band structure, and DOS; and AFLOW ICSD 644246 supplies one structure. Follow-up Bundles are not merged with the primary Bundle. Missing targets or failed routes remain gaps and are never replaced dynamically.
context_differences: Formula identity does not establish bulk versus monolayer or a polytype.
Computed and experimental records, functionals, SOC settings, and direct/indirect gaps are not interchangeable.
A scalar band gap is not a band structure or density of states.
COD and MaterialsGalaxy CODX experimental crystal structures are structural evidence, not experimental band-gap observations.
task_spec.allowed_statement: Describe this result as a capacity-bounded multi-source structural and electronic landscape. Report each source-qualified gap, structure, and exact spectral artifact only with the dimensional, phase, method, functional, SOC, directness, or modality context its source actually declares; do not infer a missing direct, indirect, or optical designation. State only that the preregistered AFLOW and Materials Project exact bulk structures match under the declared StructureMatcher parameters; this does not establish electronic, magnetic, or topological phase identity. An explicit spectral render is a derived view of the same exact artifact and adds no source evidence.
task_spec.prohibited_statement: Do not report a universal MoS2 band gap or a phase-resolved MoS2 gap answer, merge records by formula, infer a shared 2H bulk, 1H monolayer, or other phase without explicit structure matching, count COD/CODX experimental structures as experimental band-gap observations, or treat retrieval/rendering as independent experimental validation.
missing_evidence: This run retrieved no band-gap observation explicitly identified as experimental; COD and CODX experimental structures do not supply an experimental band gap.
The returned band-gap observations do not declare direct, indirect, or optical modality; that context remains unresolved rather than inferred.

Only the preregistered AFLOW and Materials Project exact bulk structures enter one fixed-parameter match; phase equivalence remains unresolved for every other cross-source record, the 2D C2DB target, and different polytypes.
The result is a capacity-bounded multi-source material landscape, not a phase-resolved MoS2 gap answer.
Any calculation or phase context absent from a returned source-qualified record remains unknown.

The all-qualified aggregate attempts every parsed qualified route, but fair Bundle-capacity sharing or a safety ceiling can yield typed partial or truncated outcomes and prevents an all-upstream-records claim.
A missing parsed band/DOS artifact is not evidence that the source has no spectrum.
task_spec.next_action: Any phase-resolved comparison beyond the one preregistered AFLOW-to-Materials-Project exact-structure match requires separately declared exact inputs; obtain separately identified experimental band-gap observations for an experiment-computation comparison and do not collapse this evidence to one MoS2 gap.
